full_name: Veterans Affairs Low Vision Visual Functioning Questionnaire
domains: navigation; resolution; peripheral detection; finding; general function (p3); principal-components of training subcomponent gave Reading (15 items) and Mobility (18 items) dimensions (p10)
response_scale: each item: (a) difficulty 6 categories: not difficult / slightly / moderately / extremely difficult / impossible / do not do it for nonvisual reasons; (b) difficulty due to vision yes/no; (c) want training yes/no; (d) how task usually performed (5 categories)
scoring: Rasch rating-scale model (WINSTEPS 3.16) measures per subcomponent
target_population: persons with low vision in vision rehabilitation programs (VA and private sector)
notes: Rasch separation/reliability for subcomponents a, b, c: S=3.91 R=.94; S=3.54 R=.93; S=3.29 R=.92 (p7 and 10; item-level). Subcomponent d showed lack of variability (p11). Factor analysis = principal-components analysis on item-measure residuals of subcomponent c (p10). Item list in Box 1 (p4).
